summary: Tested GoldMine end-to-end: 17 backend pytest tests covering auth (signup/login/me/logout/google-session), Categories/Creators/Vault/Prompts/Actions/Notes CRUD, vault platform auto-detection, move-to-action, action status transitions, dashboard stats shape, and user data isolation — all 17 PASS. Frontend Playwright covered signup -> dashboard, sidebar navigation across all 6 sections, Vault create with platform auto-detect (YouTube/X), Move-to-Action -> action card creation in Action Loop, Prompts create + copy-to-clipboard, Notes create with rich-text toolbar present, Directory create category + creator, Dashboard renders accountability-score and stat cards, logout -> login persistence — all PASS after fixing the clipboard handler.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() was called without try/catch. In sandboxed/insecure contexts the unhandled NotAllowedError surfaced as a runtime overlay (webpack-dev-server-client-overlay) which then intercepted pointer events and blocked all subsequent clicks (e.g. sidebar nav after the first copy). FIXED by wrapping in try/catch with a document.execCommand fallback and a graceful toast.error.

issues: Radix DialogContent rendered without aria-describedby / DialogDescription. Console warns: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Minor a11y issue — add a <DialogDescription> (can be sr-only) inside each DialogContent.

Score is rendered as a big '0' number followed by a separate gold '%' glyph. User choice was 'accountability score as just a number'. Either keep the number-only rendering or label clearly — current '0 %' looks like a percentage which contradicts the explicit user choice. Worth confirming with PM/user.

action_items: (Optional) Add <DialogDescription className="sr-only">…</DialogDescription> inside each DialogContent to silence the Radix a11y warning across all forms.
(Optional, design) Confirm whether dashboard accountability score should show a bare number (per user choice) or keep the '%' suffix. Currently shows '0%'.
No retest required — clipboard fix verified working (no overlay, full flow completes including notes + logout/login).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~720-line file mixing models + routes for 7 resources. As the app grows split per-resource into routes/models modules.
Mongo _id is correctly excluded from every find via projection {'_id': 0} — good.

/api/auth/logout only deletes the cookie session row; JWT bearer tokens remain valid until exp because there is no token-revocation list. Acceptable for v1 but flag for security review (verified test_logout_ok still gets 200 on /me afterwards).
set_session_cookie hard-codes secure=True, samesite='none' — fine in production over HTTPS but will not work on plain http://localhost dev. Drive from env if needed.
PromptsPage.copy lacked try/catch around navigator.clipboard — fixed.
DialogContent components missing DialogDescription -> a11y warnings.
google-session uses synchronous `requests` in async path; under load this blocks the event loop — switch to httpx.AsyncClient.
Dashboard stats: save_to_action_ratio = total_actions / total_saved can exceed 1.0 once a vault item has been deleted but the action remains. Consider clamping or labelling.
Categories cascade: deleting a category does NOT null-out category_id on creators/vault/prompts/notes. Orphan refs possible.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows after clipboard fix

test_credentials: Tests dynamically signup users with emails of pattern test_*_<rand>@goldmineapp.com / GoldMine123!. /app/memory/test_credentials.md uses domain @goldmine.app which Pydantic EmailStr rejects (reserved tld 'app' is OK actually — 'test' tld was the issue). Suggest updating that file to a non-special domain such as @goldmineapp.com.
seed_data_creation: Tests create their own users + per-test resources; cleanup performed inline via DELETE calls in each test. No persistent seed data created.

rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: signup -> /prompts -> create prompt -> click copy-prompt button. In a sandboxed/iframed Chromium context, navigator.clipboard.writeText rejects with NotAllowedError. The handler did not await with try/catch, producing an unhandled rejection that triggered React's runtime error overlay. The overlay's full-screen iframe then intercepted pointer events on all subsequent UI (sidebar, etc). Mitigation applied: wrap the writeText call in try/catch with a textarea + execCommand('copy') fallback, and toast.error on failure.
